title: astragalus sempervirens var. muticus
intro: Astragalus sempervirens var. muticus, commonly known as Huangqi or Mongolian milkvetch, is a plant species in the legume family (Fabaceae) that has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Astragalus sempervirens var. muticus include its immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help boost the immune system and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate the production of white blood cells, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-bacterial activities. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus sempervirens var. muticus include isoflavones, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
